counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证空RSS的构建流程
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify empty RSS build process

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会知晓“Quiet Feed”这个 Atom 订阅源目前是空的,共 0 篇文章;当你想从它里面查找或引用任何文章、作者、标签内容时,Claude 会如实告知暂无内容。
howto.when: 当你要测试空的 RSS 构建,或提到 Quiet Feed 并想查找其中的文章、话题、作者等内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看 Quiet Feed 最近发了什么。
say.note: Claude 会查询该 feed,发现 0 篇文章。

say.text: Quiet Feed 里有没有关于气候变化的文章?
say.note: Claude 会按主题查找,结果为空。

say.text: 这个 feed 有哪些作者?
say.note: Claude 会检查作者列表,显示 0 位。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude knows that the "Quiet Feed" Atom feed is currently empty with 0 articles; when you try to find or cite any articles, authors, or tags from it, it will truthfully say there is no content.
howto.when_en: When you need to test the empty RSS golden build, or mention Quiet Feed to look up its articles, topics, authors, etc.

say_en.text: What has Quiet Feed posted recently?
say_en.note: Claude queries the feed and finds 0 articles.

say_en.text: Are there any articles about climate change?
say_en.note: Claude searches topics and returns empty.

say_en.text: Who are the authors of this feed?
